# Every permission the released APK may ask for. The build fails if the APK asks for anything else
# (for example android.permission.INTERNET added by a library), so the privacy promise can't break silently.
# Fingerprint / phone screen lock for the hidden zone.
android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC
android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT
com.mazidulhaque.autopocket.standard.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION
